newsitem.title: FRANCE: Casino 1996 net attrib up 32.4 pct.
newsitem.headline: Casino 1996 net attrib up 32.4 pct.

text.p: (Figures in millions of French francs unless stated)

NOTE - The retail group gave its results in a statement. It said that in France, volumes from distribution rose 5.7 percent and operating earnings rose 22.7 percent. In the United States, subsidiary Smart & Final saw its sales grow 11 percent and operating income rise 29.8 percent. In Poland, where the company opened its first hypermarket last year, turnover for the first months of operation had been encouraging, it said.

It said that in a still difficult environment its cafeterias business had seen better volume growth than its competitors, without elaborating. The combined effect of lower interest rates and an 884 million franc reduction in debt allowed the group to improve its financial result by 141 million francs, it said.
